description: Round8 conservative temporal candidates for remaining Canada military range/training-area overlay gaps after round7. This pass focuses on CA rows with recommended_action=research_temporal_dates in data/reports/military_base_temporal_priority_queue.json and data/reports/military_base_temporal_remaining_gap_classes.csv. Low-confidence NRCan/GNBC candidates use the official National Defence-sourced place-name decision date only as a documented-by/existence date, not as a claimed establishment date.
scope_notes: Input scope was limited to Canada rows with recommended_action=research_temporal_dates, especially likely_base_or_facility ranges/training areas and the remaining sourceable air-base row.
Pelly Island/Nipterk Base was skipped again because this pass did not find credible military operational/start/end date evidence beyond generic place-name or oil/exploration-style references.

Rows supported only by generic mapping/weather pages were skipped unless an official NRCan/GNBC page sourced to National Defence provided a decision date and matching Canadian Forces Range and/or Training Area classification.

For NRCan/GNBC-only rows, start_year is a conservative documented-by year derived from the official decision date; the rationale explicitly avoids treating it as original establishment/opening evidence.
